title: Turn on Data Roaming
why: Your pack cannot start without it. This is the reason nine times out of ten.

title: Choose Automatic
why: This lets your phone find a network here by itself, instead of looking for your Indian one.

title: Switch the phone off and on
why: This makes it look for the network from the beginning. It often works when the first two did not.
note: Hold the side button until the screen changes.
Hold the same button until you see the logo.
after: Then wait a minute. The name of a Singapore network will appear at the top of your screen.
